LESSON: LANGUAGE GROUPS IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: PEOPLE, POPULATION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATIONS
Topic 2.1: Language groups in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Language groups in Eastern Africa
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do people migrate?
